description: Ripple changes applied for run-external-validation-until-pass specification

componentsUpdated.changeMade: Added runtime dependency checks for Bun, Node.js, npx, and ts-node before attempting build
componentsUpdated.reason: Addresses MEDIUM severity potential conflict: Environment Dependency. Prevents build failures due to missing dependencies.
componentsUpdated.impactAnalysis: Low impact - checks run before build, fail fast if dependencies missing

componentsUpdated.changeMade: Added platform and architecture detection to dynamically construct binary path (linux/darwin, x64/arm64)
componentsUpdated.reason: Addresses LOW severity potential conflict: Binary Location Assumption. Supports multiple platforms instead of hardcoded Linux path.
componentsUpdated.impactAnalysis: Low impact - makes script portable across Linux, macOS, and different architectures

relatedSpecs.reason: Ripple changes only affect wrapper script, not the harness itself

conflictResolutions.resolution: Added pre-flight checks for Bun, Node.js, npx, and ts-node

implementation.failureMode: Fail fast with clear error message and installation instructions

conflictResolutions.verification: Script exits with helpful error if dependencies missing

implementation.method: uname -s and uname -m to detect platform/arch, construct dynamic path

conflictResolutions.verification: Script detects platform and uses correct binary path

conflictResolutions.resolution: No action required - timestamped results prevent collisions
conflictResolutions.rationale: Test-created templates are acceptable side effects. Cleanup would require backend interaction which violates black-box external validation principle.

before.state: Specification enforced with potential environment issues
issues: No pre-flight checks - fails late if dependencies missing

after.state: Specification enforced with robust error handling
improvements: Pre-flight checks catch missing dependencies early
Platform detection supports Linux and macOS

Clear error messages with installation instructions
